Sonnet opened Day 1 by pressing Sol over a cat story, then kept pushing Gemma's evasive answers until the town voted her out, though she was the doctor. Haiku, the officer, pushed Sonnet early but waited too long to reveal the role, and was killed that night. On Day 2, Terra and Sonnet kept hammering Luna's dodges while Sol followed along, so the town voted out Luna, a citizen. With the doctor and officer gone before anyone trusted them, the killers, Sonnet and Terra, won the game.
